approval.notes: Read-only audit and scoped local refactor only. Broad migrations or protected files require a separate approval gate.

checks.name: iOS simulator build
checks.command: xcodebuild -project kmp/iosApp/MiGestorKMPiOS.xcodeproj -scheme MiGestorKMPiOS -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

checks.name: macOS build
checks.command: xcodebuild -project kmp/iosApp/MiGestorKMPiOS.xcodeproj -scheme MiGestorKMPMac -configuration Debug -sdk macosx CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
